verdict.rationale: Reducto's Parse endpoint converts documents to structured JSON/markdown with layout, tables, and figures, and offers configurable chunking modes explicitly designed to avoid post-processing for LLM/RAG consumption. Docs also mirror every page to markdown and provide llms.txt indexes tailored for agent/LLM consumption, reinforcing the clean-output design intent. missing for 10: explicit documentation/example showing removal of repeated headers/footers or 'page furniture' noise, and independent benchmark confirming clean output quality versus competitors.
